div.div:
core::preflight()
Unpack the embedded ONNX Runtime to a per-user cache file (pproni-<tag>/pproni.dll), decrypt the embedded BiRefNet weights (shot_classifier::cipher), then build the session.
Fails → message + exit(1), before any file is touched.

div.div:
app::progress::Progress
In-place unicode progress bar — always 40 cells (█ done / ▨ remaining), the `NN%` drawn over the cells it needs rather than after them, `MMmSSs remaining` beside it. new(total, footer, lang) / tick. Redraws throttled to ~15 Hz via non-blocking try_lock; self-disables when stdout is not a TTY. Cross-platform.

div.div:
R1 · center_and_stretch
Square = longest subject-bbox side × (1 + R1_MARGIN 4.2%). A bled edge is pinned; the slack goes to the free sides. Background bands stretch outward, horizontal pass then vertical — that is what fills the corners. Empty mask, or pins no square can respect → R3
